quests.title: There Was a Young Trainer...
quests.summary: Write a limerick for limerick night at the Poet's Rest, and try it on the Milk Market crowd.

steps.text: Get a first line from the guide at King John's Castle.
Finish the limerick with Poet Máire at the Poet's Rest: pick the lines that rhyme.
Recite it at the Milk Market and beat Bard Ruairí in a verse-off.

quests.reward: A Thomond Scrum Cap, two pieces of Limerick Lace and standing in Ireland.

quests.title: A Medieval Banquet
quests.summary: Help the Butler of Bunratty Castle lay on tonight's medieval banquet.

steps.text: Fetch a jug of mead from the barman at Durty Nelly's.
Ask the bean an tí in the Folk Park cottage for brown bread.
Find a harpist in the Bunratty Folk Park.
Back to the Butler for the banquet, and face the Earl's champion.

quests.reward: Three jugs of Bunratty Mead and standing in Ireland.

quests.title: The Foynes Coffee
quests.summary: Make a proper Irish coffee where it was invented, at the Foynes flying-boat terminal.

steps.text: Get cream from the dairy farmer north of the river.
Get brown sugar from the duty-free shop at Shannon Airport.
Make the coffee with Chef Bríd at the Foynes museum, in the right order.

quests.reward: A Cuppeen, three Irish Coffees and standing in Ireland.

quests.title: Dolphin Watch
quests.summary: Count the Shannon estuary's resident bottlenose dolphins for the survey.

steps.text: Spot the pod off the Bunratty mud.
Spot the pod by the crossing at the head of the estuary.
Spot the pod off Foynes on the south shore.
Have a firm word with Speedboat Dónal at the Foynes slip.
Report back to Skipper Gráinne at the Killimer slip.

quests.reward: Water Snares, Limerick Ham and standing in Ireland.

quests.title: The Earl Beneath the Lake
quests.summary: Wait at Lough Gur for the silver-shod horse of Gearóid Iarla.

steps.text: Walk into the Grange Stone Circle the way the midsummer sun does.
Wait by the lake shore at night for the silver-shod horse.

quests.reward: A meeting with Silvershod, and standing in Ireland.
